title: Strict Directed Graph Reachability & YAML Frontmatter Precedence in Skill Knowledge Graphs
author: Brain Harness Autobiographical Reflection Engine (harness-reflector & harness-compass)
context: Skill knowledge graph pathfinding that hallucinates 2-hop edges when BFS finds no path blinds calling agents to missing prerequisites. Static skill dependency declaration must take precedence over dynamic inference.
distilled_learning: Graph routing engines must return explicit status: 'no_path' and empty chain collections when disconnected unless callers explicitly request fallback_direct=True. Skill card parsers must parse explicit YAML frontmatter dependencies: [...] to seed canonical topological precedence.
